description:
Creates a new monitor inside Monitor Hub.

Supports:
• HTTP
• HTTPS
• API
• Ping
• TCP Port
• Keyword Monitoring

Use this tool whenever a user wants to monitor a website, API, server, endpoint, IP address or service.

Returns the newly created monitor and its initial monitoring status.

body.description: Optional HTTP request body payload for POST/PUT checks.

category.description:
Purpose: Category grouping.

Supported values:
uptime
api

headers.description: Optional custom HTTP headers to include with checks.

interval_seconds.description:
Purpose: Monitoring interval in seconds (Free: 300s, Starter: 60s, Pro/Business: 30s).

Supported values:
30
60
300
600
1800
3600

keyword.description: Expected keyword string for keyword monitors.

name.description:
Purpose: Descriptive name for the new monitor.

Example values:
Production Checkout API
Frontend Website

Validation rules: Must be a non-empty string.

target.description:
Purpose: Target URL or hostname to monitor.

Accepted values: URL or IP address.

Example values:
https://monitorhubs.com
https://api.example.com/health

type.description:
Purpose: Monitoring type.

Supported values:
http
https
tcp
port
ping
keyword

name: create_monitor
